description: The index of every SKILL.md in this repo, and the only place a skill's byte budget lives. `scripts/check-load.mjs` reads it: a skill on disk with no row here is a finding, and a row whose budget the skill exceeds is a finding. `phase` is the lifecycle step a skill owns (0-7), null when it spans the lifecycle; `family` separates the workflow set from the audit set. `supersedes` names the block of the deleted project-workflow instruction that moved here, so a reviewer can prove nothing was dropped.

skills.trigger: the lifecycle end to end: which phase comes next, what it produces, its exit gate
supersedes: copilot-instructions#The lifecycle (the two rules that cost epics)

skills.trigger: scoping an epic: the binding text, re-measuring an amendment's premises, the deferral record
writing an epic's business requirements: the README, one story file per story, AC and status
the design gate: the component set per surface, each component's state list, the human preview
building one story: the pre-implementation checks, the change checklist, Tier 1, the commit gate
closing a story: boxing the AC, the BR/IMP pair, the doc-code truth-check, status and date
closing an epic: the Phase 5 surface table by name, Tier 2, the docs audit, the carry-forward
supersedes: copilot-instructions#The lifecycle (phase 5 row and its surface list)

skills.trigger: shipping an epic as one pull request: the PR template, gate evidence, CI green
archiving closed epics in a deferred batch: which folders move, the archive exemptions
Tier 1 gates: the five commands every code change runs, and what each counts
supersedes: project-workflow#Quality gates (the single-source rule and the Tier 1 table)
project-workflow#Quality gates (the build-is-the-typecheck, npm-test and Gate-1-fast-path notes)

skills.trigger: Tier 2 gates: the pre-merge and close gates, what each counts, and when a red result is debt
supersedes: project-workflow#Quality gates (Notes that cost a run when missed)

skills.trigger: adding a quality gate: the row, the npm script, the solar command, the parity checks
auditing backend code: error message format, module boundaries, service layer
skills.when: Run before closing a backend story.

skills.trigger: auditing documentation and verification artefacts against the code they describe
skills.when: Run at an epic close, or on any doc a code change invalidated.

skills.trigger: auditing frontend code, UIUX fundamentals and the AI-slop checklist
skills.when: Run after a frontend feature and before closing a UI story.
